name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen painting?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen painting costs vary based on room square footage, ceiling height, surface condition, and whether cabinets or trim are included. Basic wall and ceiling painting for an average-sized kitchen generally ranges from several hundred to a few thousand dollars. Adding cabinet painting, extensive drywall patching, water damage repair, or crown molding installation increases overall labor and materials. An on-site assessment allows a contractor to inspect existing wall texture, grease accumulation, and trim detail to provide an accurate, fixed-scope estimate before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on kitchen square footage, ceiling height, drywall condition, grease prep requirements, and whether the scope includes cabinets, baseboards, or trim.
